notes.title: How to use Munchausen
notes.notes:
The hidden character “Munchausen” from the arcade version can now be used as a player character in Arcade Mode.

This is a port of the arcade version. By default, “Munchausen” is not displayed in the selection icon.

On the character selection screen, move the selection cursor to ”Fumiko” and press the joystick down.
The character selection will then change from Fumiko to Munchausen, which can then be selected.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493545/6fa61a06c9be0d1076bd3ff72786463a031a04a4.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45493545/5ffa041f59f7d3d053eec53b14123b151b0e8c98.png[/img]

*The "Dramatic Change Mode" that allows 2P scenarios to be viewed by 1P has not been implemented, so please use two controllers to enjoy this release.(This is why the game is also compatible with Steam Remote Play Together.)
We plan to implement this in an update at some point, but the timing has not yet been decided.

notes.title: About Online Rankings
notes.notes:
That's how to check rankings online with the Steam client.

1. Access the community page
2. Select "Rankings" from "Show Data" in the top right of the "All" tab page
3. Select the ranking you want to check from the play data page
4. You can switch the display from the pull-down menu.

*Note
The data displayed for each ranking is taken from the in-game score and is uniformly divided by 1/10.
This is to avoid the limit on the number of digits that can be displayed for Steam rankings.

notes.title: Changing the screen size
notes.notes:
By default, the game is set to arcade resolution because it is an arcade port.

You can change this in the "WINDOW SIZE" option in the OPTION menu.

OFF (Full SCREEN)
x1.0 (640x480)
x1.5 (960x720)
x2.0 (1280x960)
